// diagnostic

E0609

`use alias.item` names an item of a `priv module`

What

`use alias.item` names an item of a `priv module`

Why

A `priv module` is usable only by its enclosing module (`priv(package)`: by its package)

Fix

Import it from inside its enclosing module, or remove `priv` from the module.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0609: tests/ui/core_crypto_fd_import_is_private.stderr.

Error [jet.UsePrivateModuleItem]: `JetcFd` is private in module `core.crypto`
  --> core_crypto_fd_import_is_private.jet:4:1
    |
  4 | use core.crypto.[JetcFd]
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A Core module's API is the names it exports; its other types and helpers belong to Core alone
 Fix: Use what `core.crypto` exports instead
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0609
